text: So engineers at Farnborough, in England, did something new. They put a whole Comet fuselage into a giant tank of water. Why water? Because if it burst, water wouldn't explode outward like compressed air. Then they pumped it up and let it down, again and again, one fake flight every few minutes. After about three thousand flights, real and simulated, the skin split open, from a crack at the corner of an opening. Wreckage lifted from the sea near Elba told the same story. The crack had started at a corner of that little roof window.
